A vertical rectangular illustration features a bright blue background. At the top, a large white word "TEMPO" is centered, with smaller text above and below it. A red horizontal bar sits at the very top left. A red line graph starts at the lower left, trending upwards and to the right. 

In the center, a person wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and black pants is depicted in a dynamic pose, hanging from a large fuel pump nozzle. Their body is angled diagonally, with one leg bent upwards and the other extended downwards. Their hands grip the red line of the graph, which appears to transform into the nozzle’s hose. The person's face shows an intense expression with furrowed brows.

To the left of the person, large black text reads "Setengah Mati Subsidi." Below this, smaller black text describes government hesitation regarding fuel prices. At the bottom, there is a white rectangular area containing a barcode, a QR code, and publication details, including the date "29 AGUSTUS-4 SEPTEMBER 2022" and the price "RP 50.000."
